summary: Linux 1.0.68: reading a codeplug built elsewhere flagged 30 channels, e.g. 145.163750 MHz -> nearest 145.165. The radio holds the frequency; the driver sets has_nostep_tuning (10 Hz storage), which CHIRP's validate_memory honors, but the bridge never exported it and the app's pre-write check applied the 2.5-100 kHz steps. Affects every has_nostep_tuning radio (22 driver files).
title: Frequencies off the tuning-step grid (145.16375 MHz) flagged as unprogrammable
